name: deck
comment: Slide-deck generator for the Debezium Community Showcase. The episode-list landing page is rendered natively by Jekyll (_layouts/showcase.html + _plugins/showcase.rb), so this build only produces the standalone Marp slide decks plus their assets. The Rakefile copies ./public into _site/community/showcase during the site build.

scripts.build: rimraf public && marp --html -I deck/src -o ./public && mkdir -p public/showcase && ncp deck/src/showcase/showcase.svg public/showcase/showcase.svg
